name: Randy Starkey
prior_offices: Niobrara County sheriff (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Randy Starkey is the Niobrara County sheriff and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official general election summary lists him with 886 votes.
